Beyblade X Ratchet Tier List

Compare every Beyblade X ratchet by tournament performance. Rankings combine 1st-place conversion with repeated top-cut usage, while low-sample results remain provisional.

The current #1 ratchet in this scope is 1-60, with 35.0% of its 8,714 reported top cuts finishing 1st.

A letter tier requires at least 60 reported top cuts. “?” keeps the raw result visible without treating a small sample as a reliable ranking.
